crossRefs.note: “Go, and tell Hananiah, saying, ‘Yahweh says, “You have broken the bars of wood, but you have made in their place bars…
For Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel says, “I have put a yoke of iron on the neck of all these nations, that they…
Those who escape the sword will return out of the land of Egypt into the land of Judah few in number. All the remnant…
But he stands alone, and who can oppose him? What his soul desires, even that he does.
Your fathers, where are they? And the prophets, do they live forever?
But my words and my decrees, which I commanded my servants the prophets, didn’t they overtake your fathers? “Then they…
Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.
If we are faithless, he remains faithful; for he can’t deny himself.”

people.name: Jehoiakim
people.line: King of Judah, son of Josiah

translations.web: “Take again another scroll, and write in it all the former words that were in the first scroll, which Jehoiakim the king of Judah has burned.
translations.bsb: “Take another scroll and rewrite on it the very words that were on the original scroll, which Jehoiakim king of Judah has burned.
translations.kjv: Take thee again another roll, and write in it all the former words that were in the first roll, which Jehoiakim the king of Judah hath burned.
translations.asv: Take thee again another roll, and write in it all the former words that were in the first roll, which Jehoiakim the king of Judah hath burned.
